+# CLANG_CXX (resolved by build_tools/build_detect_platform) so it works in a gcc
+# build too. Aborts up front if no usable clang++ is available, so a bad
+# toolchain never leaves the tree in a partially regenerated state. Pin the
+# formatter to match CI with CLANG_FORMAT_BINARY, e.g.:

# Quick local validation for C API generation plus the focused C API test.
# This verifies the checked-in generated fragments as well as the inlined
# include/rocksdb/c.h and db/c.cc outputs, then runs c_test in an isolated
+# CLANG_CXX is the single clang++ detection point for the whole script: it is
+# used for CXX when building with clang, for CLANG_ANALYZER (scan-build), and by
+# tooling that needs clang even in a gcc build (e.g. the C API codegen, which
+# parses C++ ASTs). The fbcode config above already sets CLANG_CXX; otherwise
+        # Honor an already-configured clang compiler (e.g. CI sets
+        # CXX=clang++-21) so codegen parses headers with the same clang the
+        # build uses, not an unrelated clang++ that merely happens to come first
+        # on PATH (an image may ship both a bare clang++ and clang++-NN).
+        # Otherwise take the first clang++ on PATH. Candidates cover a bare
+        # clang++, versioned names, and clang++.par (a Meta-internal wrapper
+        CLANG_CXX=$(command -v clang++ || command -v clang++-21 || command -v clang++-20 \
+            || command -v clang++-19 || command -v clang++-18 || command -v clang++-17 \
+            || command -v clang++-16 || command -v clang++-15 || command -v clang++-14 \
+# If the selected C++ compiler is actually clang (e.g. clang was the only
+# compiler available), reflect that as USE_CLANG so clang-specific logic in the
+# Makefile applies consistently. Detect it via the compiler's own __clang__
+# predefined macro rather than matching the binary path, which can false-positive
+# A clang++ is always available in the fbcode toolchain regardless of whether
+# the build itself uses gcc or clang. CLANG_CXX exposes it for tooling (e.g. the
+# C API codegen, which parses C++ ASTs) that needs clang even in a gcc build.
